purpose: Preserve community catch and bait reports as auditable evidence signals without converting isolated claims into bite-status statements.

unverified_signal.label: Unverified signal
unverified_signal.minimum: Single report or otherwise insufficiently corroborated claim.
unverified_signal.public_language: Unverified signal: one recent reported catch.

corroborated_signal.label: Corroborated signal
corroborated_signal.minimum: At least two plausibly independent reports with compatible time/location/species evidence, or one report with strong geolocated photographic evidence plus an independent corroborator.
corroborated_signal.public_language: Corroborated local signal: multiple compatible recent reports.

strong_recurring_evidence.label: Strong recurring evidence
strong_recurring_evidence.minimum: Multiple independent reports recurring across a short window, normally five or more within three days, plus at least one different evidence class such as tackle-shop report, RICHFISH field observation, survey/creel evidence, or strong geolocated imagery.
strong_recurring_evidence.public_language: Strong recurring evidence: repeated recent reports supported by independent evidence.

verified_field_evidence.label: Verified field evidence
verified_field_evidence.minimum: Direct RICHFISH field observation or equivalent documented evidence with time/location/species verification. This verifies the observation, not that the bite is generally hot.
verified_field_evidence.public_language: Verified field observation at the stated time and place.

rules: Never convert one social-media post into a location-wide bite claim.
Corroborating reports must be evaluated for independence; reposts, copied captions, or the same catch shared across accounts count as one underlying observation.
A photograph can strengthen species and location confidence but does not by itself prove abundance or persistence.
Evidence ages; current-status language must consider recency and environmental comparability.
Official regulations, closures, access rules, and health advisories are separate controlling sources and cannot be overridden by community evidence.
Every derived public statement must retain the source report IDs and generation timestamp.
